text.setup: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, arms by your sides, palms facing forward.
cues: Curl the weights up without moving the elbows forward.
Lower slowly all the way down.
mistakes: Swinging the body to lift the weight.

text.setup: Hold dumbbells at your sides with palms facing your body.
cues: Curl up keeping the thumbs on top.
Lower under control.
mistakes: Shrugging the shoulders as the weight rises.

text.setup: Hold the EZ bar on the angled grips with palms facing up and arms straight.
cues: Curl the bar towards your chest with elbows still.
Lower all the way to straight arms.
mistakes: Leaning back to start each rep.

text.setup: Attach a straight bar or rope to the low pulley and stand facing the machine with arms straight.
cues: Curl the handle up keeping elbows by your sides.
Lower slowly against the cable.
mistakes: Letting the elbows drift forward.

text.setup: Stand on the middle of a band and hold an end in each hand, palms up.
cues: Curl up and squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly.
mistakes: Letting the band snap the arms down.

text.setup: Attach a rope or bar to the high pulley. Stand close with elbows tucked at your sides.
cues: Push the handle down until your arms are straight.
Let it rise until forearms are just above parallel.
mistakes: Elbows flaring and the shoulders joining in.

text.setup: Sit on an upright bench holding one dumbbell overhead with both hands cupping the top end.
cues: Lower the dumbbell behind your head by bending the elbows.
Straighten the arms back up without moving the upper arms.
mistakes: Elbows flaring wide.
Arching the lower back.

text.setup: Lie on a bench holding an EZ bar above your chest with straight arms.
cues: Bend the elbows to lower the bar towards the top of your head.
Straighten the arms back to the start.
mistakes: Letting the upper arms swing back and forth.
text.safety: Lower slowly and stop the set before form breaks; the bar travels near your face.

text.setup: Stand with light dumbbells at your sides and a slight bend in the elbows.
cues: Raise the arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Lead with the elbows and lower slowly.
mistakes: Shrugging up towards the ears.
Swinging heavy weights.

text.setup: Set a handle at the lowest pulley. Stand side-on and hold it with the far hand across the front of your body.
cues: Raise the arm out to the side to shoulder height.
Lower slowly against the cable.
mistakes: Leaning away to cheat the weight up.

text.setup: Hinge forward with a flat back holding light dumbbells under your chest, palms facing each other.
cues: Open the arms out to the sides like wings.
Lower slowly.
mistakes: Pulling with the arms bent like a row.

text.setup: Sit facing the pad with the handles set to the rear position, arms straight in front at shoulder height.
cues: Sweep the arms back and out until level with the body.
Return slowly.
mistakes: Squeezing the shoulder blades so hard the arms barely move.

text.setup: Hold a light band in front of your chest with straight arms, hands shoulder-width apart.
cues: Pull the band apart until it touches your chest.
Return slowly.
mistakes: Bending the elbows to make it easier.

text.setup: Set both pulleys at shoulder height. Stand in the middle in a split stance holding a handle in each hand, arms out wide with a slight elbow bend.
cues: Hug the handles together in front of your chest.
Open back up slowly to a comfortable stretch.
mistakes: Turning it into a press by bending the elbows a lot.

text.setup: Adjust the seat so the handles are at chest height. Sit with your back against the pad and grip the handles.
cues: Bring the handles together in front of you.
Return slowly until you feel a light chest stretch.
mistakes: Letting the handles travel so far back the shoulders strain.

text.setup: Adjust the back pad so your knees line up with the machine's pivot and the shin pad sits just above your ankles.
cues: Straighten the legs fully and squeeze the thighs.
Lower slowly.
mistakes: Kicking the weight up with momentum.

text.setup: Line your knees up with the machine's pivot and set the pad just above your heels.
cues: Curl the pad towards you as far as you can.
Return slowly to almost straight legs.
mistakes: Lifting the hips off the pad to cheat the weight.

text.setup: Lie on your back with heels on sliders or a towel, knees bent. Lift the hips into a bridge.
cues: Slide the heels out until the legs are nearly straight, keeping hips up.
Pull the heels back in.
mistakes: Hips dropping to the floor as the legs straighten.

text.setup: Stand or sit in the machine with the balls of your feet on the platform edge and heels hanging off.
cues: Rise as high as you can onto your toes and pause.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.
mistakes: Bouncing quickly through small reps.

text.setup: Stand on one foot on the edge of a step, holding a support. Hold a dumbbell in the other hand when bodyweight becomes easy.
cues: Rise up high and pause.
Lower until the heel is below the step.
mistakes: Bending the knee to help.

text.setup: Sit with your legs against the pads, set to a width that gives a comfortable stretch.
cues: Squeeze the legs together.
Open slowly back to the start.
mistakes: Starting with the pads set too wide.

text.setup: Attach a rope or bar to the high pulley. Step back, hinge slightly and hold it with straight arms at eye level.
cues: Sweep the handle down to your thighs keeping elbows almost straight.
Let it rise slowly.
mistakes: Bending the elbows so it becomes a pushdown.

text.setup: Stand holding heavy dumbbells at your sides.
cues: Lift the shoulders straight up towards the ears and pause.
Lower slowly.
mistakes: Rolling the shoulders in circles.

text.setup: Lie on your back with knees bent and fingertips lightly at your temples.
cues: Curl your shoulders off the floor by shortening the stomach.
Lower slowly.
mistakes: Pulling on the head with the hands.

text.setup: Kneel facing a high pulley holding a rope beside your head.
cues: Curl the ribs towards the hips, keeping the hips still.
Return slowly.
mistakes: Sitting back on the heels so the hips do the work.
